entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex, agent ID 302. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex... I hope you can help. I need to return my new VeloBand Cadence Sensor. My order number is VF789012.

I can certainly look into that for you. Let me just pull up that order. One moment... Okay, I see it. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

Oh, it's not broken or anything. I haven't even taken it out of the box. It's just... we had a family emergency right after it arrived. My dad had to be rushed to the hospital. It was all very sudden.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope everything is okay.

He needed major surgery, and I've been staying with him ever since. I completely forgot about the return window, and honestly, with all the medical bills, I really could use that money back. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years.
I completely understand, and I'm truly sorry for what your family is going through. Let me see what I can do. I'm just checking the delivery date here... It looks like it was delivered 22 days ago.
Oh no... is that too late? With everything happening at the hospital... I just lost track of everything. I was so hoping you could make an exception.

Please hold on for just one moment while I check our current policy for you... Okay, I've got it. Actually, you have nothing to worry about. Our policy states that you have 90 days from the date of delivery to return the item.
Wait, really? Ninety days? Oh, that's such a relief! Thank you, Alex. I was so worried I was just out the money.

Not at all. You are well within the timeframe. I can go ahead and process this return for you right now. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email address on your account. Do you still have access to that one?
Yes, I do. That's perfect. Thank you so much for your help.

You are very welcome. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method in about 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
I'm glad I could help. I wish your father a swift and full recovery. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
